criteria.requirement: Implement inflect.templates.ReportTemplate(text) with compiled unique fields and render(engine,values). Allow simple named placeholders and escaped braces; reject attribute/index access, conversion flags, arbitrary format specs and nested expressions at construction. Support raw text, :words, :ordinal, :article, :join and :counted(noun), using real engine APIs and completed counted/stream join implementations. Validate all required names before formatting, preserve repeated fields/literal braces and custom noun rules. Work on an isolated clone so number formatting does not mutate original state. No eval or method dispatch from template text; content values are not reparsed as templates.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
